verdict.rationale: Drata documents compliance workflow automation with custom triggers and actions, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows that automations, workflows or custom monitoring tests can be versioned, reviewed before changes, or rolled back. The only versioning evidence covers policies and evidence-library items, which are adjacent features and earn no credit for automation versioning.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
